properties.value: Dual-laminate FRP/HDPE/rubber-lined CS on raw-acid stages; 316L or coated CS only after pH is reliably ≥6.5
properties.note: scope: T-1006 and R-1001/R-1002/R-1003/R-1004 treatment tanks; alt: Vinyl-ester FRP throughout where abrasion and temperature are within rating; status FIRM | D-A1000-MOC: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.

properties.value: 0.64 mol/L H₂SO₄ + 0.23 mol/L HCl: 179 t/d H₂SO₄, 24 t/d HCl, 129 kmol/d H₃PO₄; 1,070 mg/L Mn, 760 mg/L K, 1,400 mg/L P — dilute acid, not wastewater
properties.note: D-A1000-01: REP-038 first-principles load adopted as the design statement: 0.64 mol/L H₂SO₄ + 0.23 mol/L HCl (179 t/d H₂SO₄, 24 t/d HCl) with Mn / K / P — the feed is dilute acid, not wastewater.

properties.value: Acid recovery (150–200 t/d spent-acid reconcentration, 1.5–4.4 MW at 150–200 °C) removes ≈ 95 % of the A-1000 load — 'largest single design lever in the project' (REP-026 F-39); A-1000/A-2000 not to be frozen before the recovery decision
properties.note: D-A1000-01: Acid recovery is the governing design lever for A-1000 / A-2000 (REP-026 F-39, REP-039); A-1000 not to be frozen before it.
